title: Austin: Appointments, Growth Plans, Meeting Ends Early
summary:
*   A presentation detailed the Planning and Growth Management Department's business plan.
*   E.K. Tucker and Mike Anderson were appointed as members of the Private Industry Council.
*   The meeting concluded prematurely due to a lack of a quorum, preventing discussion of any further agenda items.
transcript:
FOUNDER 1029
Austin City Council
MINUTES
For May 03, 1988
-
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
FOURTH FLOOR AUDITORIUM
Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To:
-
-
CENTRAL LIBRARY
3:00 Ρ.Μ.
Mayor Cooksey called to order the special called meeting of the Council, noting the
absence of Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, Councilmembers Shipman and Urdy.
Norm Standerfer, Director, Planning and Growth Management Department, showed slides
illustrating the Planning and Growth Management Department Business Plan presentation.
Councilmember Humphrey had to leave the meeting early so the following motion was made;
Motion
The Council, on Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's motion, Councilmember Humphrey's second,
appointed E.K. Tucker and Mike Anderson as members of the Private Industry Council. (4-0
Vote, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, Councilmembers Urdy and Shipman absent) Councilmember
Humphrey left the Council meeting at 3:45 p.m.
At that point there was not a quorum, but Mr. Standerfer continued with his presentation.
The Council meeting was concluded at 4:17 p.m., without a quorum. No other items on the
agenda were discussed.
